title: The page says the bank account is preferred
assertion: The Payment method card, with Stripe and with the simulator, leads its description with the bank account; with nothing on file it says "A bank account (ACH) is preferred for annual plans and audits."; with a card on file it says that and "A new payment method replaces the one on file."; with a bank account on file it says only the second; a card's brand reads as a person reads it; the simulator lists its bank form before its card form, each with a request key of its own; the page shows the Payment method card before the Plan card, and with nothing on file the Plan card shows the prices and asks for a method instead of offering a plan; the practice onboarding step reads "Add a payment method and choose a plan"
noFileReason: The Payment method card is rendered from props the test passes, and the page from a synthetic organization on the local simulator; no file.
